Article 4.3 requires exactly 'Photos of the damage; repair quote' for C3 glass claims

verdict.summary: All facts match the email and the repair quote, and the claim is payable (in time, covered under C3 glass breakage, documents provided, no exclusion, playbook commercial-vehicle rule not triggered), but the recorded coverage is C2 collision instead of C3 glass breakage, so the staged deductible/payout are based on the wrong coverage code.
